name: GitHub Copilot CLI
description: Adds GitHub Copilot CLI (measured on 1.0.91) as a backend the launcher can spawn. Its lifecycle hooks reach the daemon through this plugin's loopback sink; nothing is written to ~/.copilot or to the repo.

settings.label: Permission hold
settings.note: How long a Copilot permission request waits for a tap on the phone before Copilot shows its own dialog in the terminal. Kept below the hook's own timeout so Copilot never kills the hook.
